objective: 冻结带版本的 MCU 逻辑帧契约、遥测语义、故障码含义、关联/时序行为与复位权限，同时不声称二进制 CAN 载荷编码或物理硬件行为已经过验证。
acceptance: protocol version 1.0 defines command, ack, telemetry, stop and stop_ack as disjoint fail-closed frame shapes
ordinary command and ack identifiers occupy 0 through 32767 while stop and stop_ack identifiers occupy 32768 through 65535
every fault code has one deterministic documented meaning and successful acknowledgements cannot carry a fault
15-bit command serial wrap, exact retry behavior and stale/conflicting duplicate rejection are deterministic
sender-local monotonic timestamps are not treated as cross-device freshness evidence and invalid or duplicate traffic cannot feed the link watchdog
protocol version 1.0 exposes no reset frame and no protocol frame can grant reset authority
unknown fields, unknown enum values, clock/timestamp mismatches and frame-kind field ambiguity are rejected
the JSON Schema and exported Pydantic McuFrame model accept and reject the same contract test corpus
the repository Schema Compiler can consume the protocol metadata and preserves command-ID partition bounds
the committed stop_ack example validates through JSON Schema and Pydantic
make test and make contract pass
evidence: `tests/unit/test_mcu_protocol_contract.py` 的 Schema Compiler 兼容性检查
`interfaces/examples/mcu-frame-stop-ack.json` 经 Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema 与 Pydantic 的往返验证
stop_conditions: 二进制 CAN 载荷布局将不得不凭空发明，而非源自已批准的固件协议
该改动需要编写 `firmware` 或 `robot/control` 代码
